name: Chartered Capital and Investment Limited
about: Chartered Capital and Investment Limited provides consultancy and merchant banking services in India. The company engages in merchant banking activities, which include public issue management, including SME IPO, right issues, buyback offers, delisting offers, qualified institutions placement, and employee stock option and employee stock purchase schemes. The company also offers valuation and other corporate advisory services. Chartered Capital and Investment Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
